title: NetLayer Labs: team pitch for Monad Metropolis
voice: the founder's own recording (public/audio/vo, built by scripts/timing.mjs from .cache/voice-clean.wav)

scenes.text: We're NetLayer Labs. An independent product studio and research lab, based in Italy.
Founded by MrNetwork. We build autonomous agents, onchain infrastructure, and the apps people use on top of them.
Five products shipped. Three live on mainnet. Calmr took first place, and four thousand dollars, at the Visko Orbis challenge. All of it open source.
Trading on chain, we kept hitting the same unfair moment. When a position is liquidated, bots race on gas, and the trader pays a penalty no market ever set.
So we built Paraclr. It turns liquidation into a per-block auction, in eight lanes built for Monad's parallel execution. Live on testnet today, every number measured.
Deterministic safety. Real numbers. NetLayer Labs.
